task_message:
Case M25: segment the myxoid soft-tissue tumor on this T2-weighted MRI.

Volume: 300x300x280 voxels, 1 mm isotropic. Budgets: max 40 tool calls / 15 model prompts / 10 min wall time.
Start with `seg_open`. Finish with `seg_finish`.
final_assistant_text: Segmentation complete. Final mask v4 (107.9 mL, single component) captures the posteromedial myxoid tumor; inferior diffuse brightness proven to be subcutaneous fat (seeding it flooded into fat) and correctly excluded, past-mask review panels show no residual nodular tumor.
